parts.text: Make these actual calls in order: load_skill review; load_skill review again to demonstrate its unchanged no-op result; load_skill absent to demonstrate the unavailable-name refusal. Do not make any other calls or retry refusals. Then briefly report the three actual results.

[skill read activation 2]
Use list_directory to inspect available scratch files before changing them.

[/skill]

[skill review activation 3]
Inspect scratch files and explain findings.

[/skill]

You help with scratch files. Load a discoverable skill before using its capability.
